thread:
maria_ml: Hey team — prepping to onboard hera-4b-int8 to staging. Quick checklist: weights path, tokenizer sanity, runtime config, and golden/toolcall smoke. Can folks do quick checks today?

aj_dev: I can take weights + runtime config. Where are the artifacts?

maria_ml: s3://models/redwood/hera/4b/int8/v1/weights.tar.gz and registry entry is `hera-4b-int8:v1` (model-store). Note: weights split into shards-0..3.

sophie_re: I'll run tokenizer diff. Saw a weird duplicate <|bos|> token when tokenizing certain prompts in local unit tests. Might be tokenizer-vocab mismatch.

aj_dev: quick config note — runtime json has kv_cache=true, max_kv_items omitted. CI lint flags it but didn't fail. Example config snippet I pushed: ```json
{
  "model": "hera-4b-int8:v1",
  "batching": { "max_batch_size": 8, "prefill_batch_size": 2 },
  "kv_cache": true,
  "quantization": "int8"
}
```

maria_ml: thanks. @aj_dev can you add max_kv_items default 2048? Also ensure `prefill_batch_size` <= `max_batch_size` (we had a mismatch earlier).

aj_dev: will do. Also note the weights tar includes a metadata.json with `vocab_version: 3` — that might be the tokenizer mismatch.

sophie_re: ran tokenizer diff vs our reference vocab v2. Differences: 137 token ids changed, and special tokens mapping differs (we have both "<|bos|>" and "<bos>" present). Quick reproducer: ```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('Hello').tokens)
```

sophie_re: patch idea: normalize special tokens in metadata -> canonicalize to the angle-bracket form `<|bos|>` and update tokenizer.json accordingly. But need to check downstream evals for regression.

maria_ml: good catch. @sophie_re please create small mapping script and a golden-to-deploy checklist item. We'll run regression on the golden set after.

sophie_re: created PR #842 with mapping script and a small test. Also added a note to the model manifest: `tokenizer_normalized: true`.

deploy-bot: CI: model-store upload for hera-4b-int8:v1 succeeded — checksum ok. Integration tests queued (4 jobs).

taylor_sre: FYI I saw high mem spikiness when kv_cache defaulted to unlimited in a different model—so please define `max_kv_items`. If we hit OOM we should fallback to non-kv path.

aj_dev: added `max_kv_items: 2048` and a runtime fallback policy: `fallback: { "mode": "disable_kv_on_oom" }` in the config. Pushed to staging branch.

maria_ml: next: golden prompts / toolcall smoke. Our gold suite includes structured outputs for the `website_search` tool. Sophie, did your tokenizer change affect structured output tests?

sophie_re: ran the golden set pre- and post-normalization. Most structured outputs matched, but 6/120 cases failed where toolcall arg `url` got truncated (tokenization boundary inserted inside a URL). Example failure snippet: ```json
expected: {"tool": "website_search", "args": {"url": "https://example.com/docs/intro"}}
actual:   {"tool": "website_search", "args": {"url": "https://example.com/docs/in"}}
```

sophie_re: seems like int8 quant + tokenizer change shifted logits slightly and caused early stop in generation for some edge-case long URLs.

maria_ml: hmm. Options: 1) extend max generation length for toolcall context, 2) adjust tokenizer to avoid splitting URLs (add url tokens), 3) post-process to validate toolcall args and retry if malformed. Thoughts?

aj_dev: 3 is low-risk: after model returns a toolcall, validate args against schema and if it fails, run a single re-query with a higher max_new_tokens=64 with `temperature=0.0` and `force_toolcall=true`. We already have retry hooks in Console.

taylor_sre: agree, implement safe-guard in routing layer. We'll also add an alert for repeated malformed toolcalls to avoid silent failures.

sophie_re: I'll try adding URL token heuristics (treat full url as one token) in tokenizer fallback, but that may require vocab rebuild which is heavy. I'll prototype post-process retry first.

maria_ml: plan: @aj_dev add post-call validation+retry hook; @sophie_re prototype tokenizer heuristic and run golden eval again; @taylor_sre add alerting rule for malformed toolcalls > 5/min. Target: green on golden smoke in staging by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:

aj_dev: assigned. PR for retry hook incoming (draft). Also added unit test for schema validator.

sophie_re: running full golden run now (120 cases). Posting results in thread when done.

deploy-bot: Integration tests finished: 3 passed, 1 flaky (toolcall-schema-unit) — collecting logs.

sophie_re: quick update — after retry hook emulation locally, 5 of the 6 failures auto-recover; one still fails consistently (special char in a query param). Uploading logs: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/4912/logs

maria_ml: thanks. If one remains, let's quarantine that golden case and create a follow-up to decide whether to patch tokenizer or accept edge-case and improve retry heuristics.

taylor_sre: I'll add the alert and a dashboard widget for malformed toolcalls.

maria_ml: perfect. I'll update the onboarding checklist and mark weights/config/tokenizer steps as done once PRs merge. Thanks everyone :tada:

aj_dev: merging runtime config PR now.

sophie_re: golden run complete: 119/120 passed after retry hook enabled. Opening ticket ENG-1298 for the remaining case.

maria_ml: closing loop — moving hera-4b-int8 to canary tomorrow morning. Ping here if anything blocks.

-- end of thread --
